technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Eureka client for service registration and discovery.
Leverage Spring Boot Actuator for metrics collection and exposure.
Implement SPI interfaces for controller abstraction to support multiple Admin SPI implementations.
Use Redis as the default persistence backend for module metrics.
Adopt GitHub Actions for CI workflows due to its integration with DockerHub and existing Spring ecosystem.
Refactor controllers to delegate logic to SPI implementations, ensuring loose coupling.
assumptions: Existing Spring XD modules can be ported to s-c-s with minimal architectural changes.
CI infrastructure (e.g., GitHub Actions) is already available and configured.
Team is familiar with Spring Cloud, Spring Boot, and Docker ecosystems.
Eureka server is already deployed and accessible for service registration.
Redis is available as a managed service or can be provisioned for metrics persistence.
SPI interfaces for Admin implementations are either pre-defined or can be created as part of the refactoring.

activities.activity_name: Eureka Integration for Module State Updates
activities.activity_description: Implement Eureka client integration to allow modules to register/update their current state with Eureka for service discovery.
Refactor ContainersController, StreamsController, ModulesController, and JobsController to delegate logic to Admin SPI implementations.

activities.activity_name: Capture Module Metrics via REST APIs
activities.activity_description: Implement metrics collection using Spring Boot Actuator and SI APIs, exposing metrics through REST endpoints.
Configure xd-admin server to self-register with Eureka as a discoverable endpoint.

activities.activity_name: Set Up CI Builds for s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Configure CI pipeline for automated building and testing of s-c-s code commits.
Migrate existing FTP modules from Spring XD to s-c-s as source modules for streaming pipelines.
Implement metrics persistence using Spring Boot's export API with Redis as the default backend.

activities.activity_name: CI Workflow for Docker Image Upload
activities.activity_description: Create CI workflow to build, bundle, and upload the module-launcher Docker image to DockerHub.
